name: SiloWeave – Automated Internal Links
author: zeaxth2bee

sections.description:
SiloWeave – Automated Internal Links is a modern, high-performance automated internal link builder for WordPress featuring a Dual-Mode Engine: User Control (precision manual rules) and Autonomous Auto-Pilot (intent-aware topical graph linking).

SiloWeave provides an intelligent, set-and-forget internal linking engine that discovers semantic entities, detects reader intent (Commercial, Educational, Tactical, Pillar), enforces category silo isolation, and prevents over-optimization.

Features

  • Dual-Mode Engine (User Control + Plugin Control):
    • Manual Rules (User Control): Define exact keyword-to-URL pairs with fine-grained toggles for custom anchors, rel attributes, and target URLs.
    • Autonomous Intent Engine (Plugin Control): Scans your published posts, extracts high-signal semantic entities, and automatically interlinks related articles without typing a single rule.
    • Hybrid Mode (Recommended): Manual rules claim priority first; the autonomous engine seamlessly fills remaining link capacity.
  • 4-Tier Reader Intent Classifier: Automatically maps targets into Educational/Definition, Commercial/Solution, Tactical/How-To, and Pillar Hubs so readers receive natural contextual links based on their user journey.
  • Strict Topical Silo Isolation: Enforces category and tag boundaries so multi-topic or lifestyle sites never cross-link unrelated niches (e.g. Coffee brewing never links to Fitness squats or Cybersecurity).
  • Zero-Regex State Machine Parser: Replaces plain text keywords safely without ever corrupting HTML attributes (alt, src, title), existing links (<a>), headings (<h1>–<h6>), code blocks (<pre>, <code>), or Gutenberg comments.
  • Strict SEO Spam Guardrails:
    • Max Links Per Post: Stop over-optimizing your content by setting a global cap (e.g. 3 links per article).
    • Max Links Per Target URL: Ensure each target URL is only linked once per post to prevent redundant anchor spam.
    • Automatic Self-Link Prevention: Posts and pages will never automatically link to themselves.
  • 1-Click Rule Promotion: Review auto-discovered links in the Intent Graph dashboard and promote any suggestion into an editable manual rule with one click.
  • Live Link Simulator & Visual Auditor: Logged-in administrators can append ?siloweave_debug=1 to any post to visually inspect which links were generated with color-coded intent badges.
  • 100% Cache Compatible & Blazing Fast: Zero database overhead on frontend page requests thanks to transient caching. Fully compatible with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, Cloudflare, and Varnish.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the siloweave-internal-links folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > SiloWeave to configure your global limits and add your first keyword-to-URL rules.
  4. View any post on your site to see your new internal links automatically generated.
sections.faq:
Does this modify my database or permanently alter post content?

No. SiloWeave operates non-destructively on the_content display filter. Your original post database entries remain completely clean and untouched. If you deactivate the plugin or delete a rule, links disappear instantly without needing any database cleanup.

Will this cause over-linking?

No. SiloWeave was built with strict SEO safety controls. By default, it enforces a maximum of 3 links per post, never links to the same destination twice, and never links a post to itself.

Can I exclude headings like H2 and H3?

Yes. By default, SiloWeave automatically excludes <h1> through <h6>, buttons, blockquotes, and code tags from being linked.

Does this work with page caches like WP Rocket or LiteSpeed?

Yes. SiloWeave executes at the WordPress filter level before cache generation, meaning pages are cached with the links intact at maximum server speed.
